title: Chapter 1385
text:
Realmless King? What the hell was that? It sounded quite scary.

Han Xiao raised his brows with interest.

If the problem here was purely the secondary dimension with strange rules, it would be a little troublesome. However, it was actually a sentient life form that could communicate, so it was much easier to deal with.

At this moment, it was as if he was in a real deep sea. The huge water pressure came from all directions, covering the sky and the earth. However, this pressure only made his body tighten slightly and could not cause any damage. Compared to the Dragon Emperor's force field, this little bit of strength could not even be considered a massage. At most, it felt like he was wearing a layer of tights.

The secondary dimension world was very dangerous, but if one reached the level of a peak Beyond Grade A, most of the dangers would not be a threat, especially when he was one of the best among the peak Beyond Grade As. As long as it was not an anomaly like the Celestial Star Alliance, it would not be a problem.

Han Xiao floated where he was and did not care about the pressure around him. His body did not move at all.

He asked curiously, "What is this Realmless King you're talking about?"

As soon as he said that, another mental message was sent over with an even more majestic aura.

"The Realmless King was born in the Black Sky Storm and rose from the void. He is the Lord of Millions of Dimensions, the Hunter of Thousands of Worlds. Any life form that steps into his territory is a servant under the royal authority!"

Whoa! The scene suddenly became magical.

"Not bad. Such a long title, I feel like he's about to catch up to me."

Han Xiao grinned.

It sounded like a powerful dimensional god that occupied the deep secondary dimensions. If an ordinary Beyond Grade A encountered him, his life might be in danger … Unfortunately, he was not an ordinary Beyond Grade A.

While he was pondering, this voice became stronger and stronger. It was as if a large bell was ringing in his mind, reverberating with a powerful aura.

"Foreign life form, leave this place immediately, or I will expel you!"

"You want to try?"

Han Xiao raised his brows and mobilized the cells in his body. It was as if he had activated a mini reactor, suddenly pumping out energy.

Chi!

Golden electric arcs shot out of his body, leaving behind scorching light marks as if they had split the surrounding black sea.

He flipped his palm, and a ball of light blue psionic energy appeared in his palm. It released a spherical shockwave that stirred up endless ripples on the surface of the sea.

Although he did not know what was going on in this secondary dimension, the fact that his previous probing had no effect was most likely due to the lack of energy.

Because he was worried about harming Harrison and the expedition fleet, Han Xiao did not explode with too much energy at once to blow up the entire secondary dimension. Instead, he controlled the energy output and increased it bit by bit.

At first, there was no change. The burst of energy was like a stone sinking into the ocean, not causing any reaction. But after a while, the black liquid substance that filled the entire space began to vibrate faintly, as if it had exceeded the limit of its tolerance, setting off large waves. It was like the tentacles of a squid on an iron plate that were agitated and rolled up.

Rumble!

Amidst the tremors, Han Xiao sensed streams of undercurrents with strong impact gushing toward him. At the same time, he felt a piercing pain in his brain, as if he had been attacked on the mental level.

But to him, it was like scratching an itch. In the blink of an eye, his HP bar was full.

This black liquid substance was strange, causing his energy perception and detection radar to fail. He could not find the other party's location, so he could only use brute force to force the other party to show up. If this was a dimensional consciousness body, then the dimension itself was the other party's body. Releasing energy from it was equivalent to continuously giving the other party enemas. Sooner or later, the other party would not be able to hold on.

Not long after, the entire space began to vibrate violently, as if it would explode and disintegrate at any time. The mental attack became weaker and weaker, and it was already filled with pain.

Han Xiao looked around and narrowed his eyes.

"Still not coming out? Do you really want me to burst? "

As soon as he said that, the pressure around him suddenly lightened. The black liquid substance shrank as if it had turned into a vortex. The black sea poured into it, like a bathtub full of water with a plug pulled out.

As the black sea faded, Han Xiao's energy perception quickly recovered, and his vision returned to normal.

This secondary dimension was a white world with nothing in it. It was like a secondary dimension that had yet to be fully formed, and it was also like all matter had been swept away by the receding black sea.

In the distant horizon, a black vortex that was getting smaller and smaller was floating. It sucked away all the black matter and was about to open a spatial rift, wanting to escape in a panic.

"Running? I'll break your legs! "

Han Xiao opened his hand, and mechanical soldiers appeared one after another along with Mechanical Force arcs. The scene was like scattering beans into soldiers.

The mechanical army that appeared released the binding force field without hesitation and grabbed the black substance, preventing it from moving. At the same time, they used the special spatial device of the secondary dimension version to mend the spatial rift that the other party had torn open.

This black liquid substance had strange characteristics and was slippery. However, under the control of Han Xiao's mechanical army, it was still fixed on the spot and turned into a high-density liquid ball. It kept changing shape and moving left and right as if it was struggling.

At the same time, mental fluctuations kept shooting out in all directions with this liquid as the center. The solemn atmosphere from before was gone, leaving only shock and anger.

"Foreign life form! You will definitely pay the price for your actions now. The Realmless King will take it from you! "

Han Xiao turned a deaf ear to it and told the mechanical army to increase the Binding Field. He then took out a cylindrical container, and like a whale swallowing the ocean, he put this mass of matter into it and compressed it into a fist-sized liquid ball. It floated in the container, and thin electric arcs stuck to it, causing the liquid to tremble non-stop. It was very painful.

This was the equipment he had specially made when he captured Primal Esper Ability Entities. He did not expect it to be suitable for this strange substance.

After being locked in the container, the liquid finally stopped. Han Xiao knocked on the outer wall of the container and asked curiously, "What are you?

"Who do you think you are? Also, did a fleet pass by here recently? Where did you take them? "

"So you're looking for that group of people. Looks like you're a high-level life form from the main material universe!" The mental fluctuations of this liquid were unstable and had already been dyed with a layer of fear. However, it quickly turned into anger. "I'm just one of the guardians of the million dimensions. I've already offered them to the Realmless King. If you have the guts, go find him!"

"Offered?" Han Xiao raised his brows. "Tell me everything you know … Forget it, seeing that you're not cooperating, I'll interrogate you."

Han Xiao poured his Mechanical Force into the container, and lightning flashed and thunder rumbled in the container, forming a miniature ion thunderstorm. This ball of liquid was like a bug trapped in an electric mosquito swatter, crackling from the electricity.

After torturing for a while, Han Xiao finally got the information he wanted from the other party.

This liquid life form was essentially an energy field life form, born in a secondary dimension that nurtured field-type life forms. This black liquid substance was the shell given to it by the so-called Realmless King. It claimed to be one of the guardians of the million dimensions, the confidant of the Realmless King (doubtful). Its name was Bobanica, which meant 'erosion' and 'devouring'.

Through this black substance, the Realmless King devoured the matter and energy of various dimensions, transforming them into his own 'territory'. He occupied this area with a large group of guardians under him, guarding the dimensions that he occupied.

The fleet that Harrison was in was indeed taken away by him. Through the special connection between the black liquid substance and the Realmless King, he used dimensional teleportation and sent it to the 'King's Land' where the Realmless King was. This was the main job of guardians like Bobanica. They intercepted the passing life forms and gave them to the Realmless King as' offerings'.

"Tsk, looks like I have to find this Realmless King if I want to fish him out … With Harrison's luck, I don't know if it's good or bad for him to encounter such a thing."

Han Xiao stroked his chin.

He pondered for a few seconds, shook his head, changed into the Dimension Travel mechanical suit, set the coordinates given by Bobanica, and shuttled toward the Realmless King.

…

In the center of a certain secondary dimension, on a huge platform that looked like a black crystal, Harrison was floating in midair. His eyes were closed as if he had lost consciousness, but his face maintained a pained expression.

One end of a black mist-like energy stream was connected to his glabella, and the other end was connected to a huge black finger. Light flowed on it.

The owner of the finger was a black entity the size of a mountain. It was humanoid with several heads and a large number of arms. At this moment, it was sitting on a black throne — it was the Realmless King.

After a while, the Realmless King retracted the energy stream. Harrison lost the power to float and fell onto the platform, still unconscious.

"Interesting. That tree has a new prey. I can harvest some sweet souls again …"

The Realmless King let out a low laugh, but to others, it would only be a frenzied roar.

As a powerful entity in the secondary dimension, the souls of life forms were rare delicacies. However, he could not completely descend into the main material universe and could only project a portion of his power. Furthermore, the main material universe was extremely vast. Without coordinates, he could only wander in the boundless starry sky, and it would be very difficult to find life forms.

At this moment, he had absorbed the memories of these life forms in the main material universe and learned the coordinates and a large amount of information of the three Universal Civilizations. He also knew that the famous World Tree Civilization was fighting with them. In his eyes, this was a feast to harvest souls.

Under normal circumstances, even a powerful dimensional entity like him would be afraid of the power of a Universal Civilization and would not be willing to provoke them.

However, if a Universal Civilization fell into a war, the situation would be different. He still had the guts to take advantage of the situation.

"You've provoked that tree. Your doomsday is coming. Hehe, instead of becoming its servant, you might as well become my food … However, the World Tree actually has the weakness of a main body? This is the first time I know. "

The Realmless King moved his body, making rustling sounds like countless insects crawling.

Then, the countless eyes on his body looked at the unconscious Harrison on the platform. Greed and desire appeared in his eyes, but he quickly suppressed them.

"It's rare to meet a life form with strong providence. If I eat you, my karma power will increase by a level … Unfortunately, the guy behind you is not to be trifled with. It's better to make a deal with him."

The Realmless King looked away.

From Harrison's memories, he saw Han Xiao's figure and knew that the two of them had a close relationship.

He was sufficiently afraid of the top experts of the main material universe. It was precisely because he saw a backer like Black Star that he did not dare to eat Harrison immediately.

The Realmless King knew very well that this was one of the ways to display the power of karma. However, he did not plan to violate it because there was a high chance that there would be a price for violating the power of karma. If he stubbornly ate Harrison, the price would most likely be this ferocious person called Black Star coming to kill him.

At this moment, a black substance suddenly fell from the black fog and floated in front of the Realmless King. It contained the emergency message from Bobanica before he was captured, showing the image of Han Xiao releasing energy to open the black sea.

"Oh? He came so quickly. It seems like this useless Bobanica won't be able to escape from his grasp and will give out my coordinates. This is good too. I'll wait for him to come and find me. "

Seeing this, the Realmless King moved his body and changed into a comfortable position, waiting for Han Xiao to come.

Black Star was very strong and might have the ability to threaten his life, but the Realmless King did not panic at all.

In terms of secondary dimension exploration, the World Tree was far ahead of the three Universal Civilizations. Although the Realmless King did not have any interactions with the World Tree Civilization, he knew how to send messages to the World Tree Blessed Race.

The information he obtained from the memories of this expedition team included the coordinates of the secondary dimensions of the three Universal Civilizations and various other information. This was the best leverage, and he believed that the World Tree would be happy to accept this gift.

However, the Realmless King had no intention of leaking the information. After all, he did not want to have too much contact with the World Tree. In comparison, he was more interested in Black Star, a guest from a new Universal Civilization.
